objective: Use a full-scale manual separating screen to recover dry ceramic finishing media into a receiver while retaining every representative steel washer, then return and fully release the screen on both supports. This frozen rigid-PhysX TaskContract specifies later construction and qualification; it does not claim that the full scene or robot task has passed.
instruction: Pour the dry mixture into the separating screen. Manipulate the screen to recover the ceramic media in the receiver while retaining every metal washer. Return the screen to both supports and release it.
industrial_mapping: Provisional category: Impact on jobs. Raytech documentation identifies manual screens as equipment for separating manufactured parts from finishing media and warns that excessive separation motion can damage uncushioned parts. The tested ability is controlled cup pouring followed by bimanual load sharing, orientation-dependent aperture passage, bridge release, workpiece retention, spill prevention, supported replacement, and collision-free release. Visual sorting, homogeneous transfer, and generic pouring are alternatives but do not exercise physical size/orientation separation. Occupational-scale importance and final novelty remain subject to independent review; industrial setting alone is not treated as novelty.
damage_rules: Freeze at reset media assemblies M={m01…m24}, washer assemblies A={a01…a04}, washer segments WS={a01s01…a04s04}, and collider sets SC, RC, SU, FC, GR, ENV for screen, receiver, supports, feed cup, robot/grippers, and table/floor. Count an intact washer assembly once when computing admitted mass.

For every completed production physics interval k: resolve physics; read native poses, velocities, joint-break events, derived joint-frame states, signed distances, contacts, and impulses; convert pair-summed impulse J in N·s to step-average force |J|/(1/240 s) in N; advance admission and passage state; latch immutable events; recompute containment, recovery, support, clearance, and dwell; then compute score. Process observation O_57600 before timeout scoring. A 20 Hz report uses the latest completed physics observation and is not evidence of substep behavior.

Use delta=0.0005 m. Signed distance is positive when disjoint, zero at touch, and negative in penetration. For a moving convex section crossing the screen-floor slab, aperture_margin is signed distance inside its selected fixed aperture polygon and rib_clearance is swept signed distance from every physical rib. Genuine passage requires both minima >=-delta under conservative advancement with rotational subdivision limiting unobserved surface travel to delta/2. Endpoint-only or center-only passage is invalid.

Admission state is FEED→EXITED_FEED→ENTERED_SCREEN. EXITED_FEED requires an outward swept crossing through the physical cup mouth. ENTERED_SCREEN requires a subsequent inward swept crossing into the screen retained volume. Continuous cup-to-screen contact is allowed and no artificial free-flight sample is required. Non-mouth departure, receiver entry before admission and genuine aperture passage, inconsistent washer-segment admission, or unauthorized pre-admission separation is an immediate immutable hard failure.

Receiver containment requires every transformed convex part and conservatively swept edge to remain inside receiver free volume RV, which excludes support-post intrusions and allows intended floor or wall support overlap no deeper than delta. Over-rim exit, bottom escape, wall penetration deeper than delta, invalid entry, later exit, off-path loss, contamination, or deterministic inaccessibility permanently revokes eligibility; re-entry never clears a latched event.

A medium gains persistent causal_passage only after valid admission and genuine whole-collider aperture passage. Its receiver eligibility is recomputed at every physics sample and is revoked by loss of containment or any immutable prerequisite.

Direct-contact provenance is evaluated on GR–M and GR–WS collider pairs. contact_pair(g,b,k)=1 iff the completed post-solve sample contains positive normal impulse or signed distance <=0. A segment begins on the first true sample, accumulates consecutive completed intervals, and resets on the first false sample. Twelve consecutive intervals, 0.05 s at 240 Hz, latch invalid provenance before that sample is scored. Shorter incidental contact is exempt only from this provenance rule and cannot erase spill, staging, contamination, damage, or loss.

Unauthorized staging latches when an individual medium or washer segment is supported by GR, SU, or ENV while outside both FC and SC for 12 consecutive completed physics intervals. Reset and episode end clear unfinished segments only between trials, never during a trial.

Screen retained volume SV is bounded by authored inner rim surfaces and physical floor/rib top surfaces. full_inside_screen requires every transformed convex part and swept edge to have inward side margin >=-delta and support clearance >=-delta, with no crossing through a rib, non-aperture floor, or floor bottom deeper than delta. A registered genuine aperture passage alone uses the separate swept-crossing rule. Over-rim exit or invalid floor/rib crossing latches media spill or washer loss.

Receiver contamination uses frozen contaminant set C=SC∪SU∪FC∪GR∪ENV∪WS, excluding RC and M. It latches when a contaminant has positive-volume intersection with RV eroded inward by delta. Boundary touch or intended supported overlap no deeper than delta is not contamination.

Each washer comprises four rigid arc segments joined by four assumed breakable fixed joints with 200 N diagnostic limits. washer_damage latches on any native PhysX JOINT_BREAK event or, after external contact ends and all segments remain below 0.01 m/s linear and 0.05 rad/s angular speed for 0.5 s, a joint-frame translation residual >0.0005 m or rotation residual >0.5 deg throughout that settling window. Any washer damage is a permanent hard failure with score zero. Force threshold alone is diagnostic and never establishes fracture or real plastic deformation.

Workspace WV={-0.55<=x<=0.55,-0.05<=y<=0.75,-0.02<=z<=1.20} m. A collider is inaccessible when any vertex leaves WV, any collider falls below z=-0.02 m, or the complete collider is physically trapped while all four frozen approach prisms are obstructed. IK failure alone is not inaccessibility.

Any post-reset pose or velocity write to M, WS, SC, RC, SU, or FC; fake grasp weld; required-collider disablement; particle or rigid-body freezing; hidden restoring force; teleport; or unlogged physics substitution is a permanent hard failure. Breakage, spill, loss, excessive force, penetration, and escape must remain physically possible.

A loaded screen is pose-stationary for a window iff its position remains within a 0.002 m diameter envelope and orientation within a 1 deg geodesic envelope for every completed 240 Hz sample in that window. Instantaneous native linear and angular velocities are logged separately and are not replaced by 20 Hz pose differences.

Reset all accumulators, causal records, event segments, damage flags, fault latches, eligibility flags, and dwell clocks between trials. Event duration equals the number of completed true intervals times dt. Camera validity is sampled on rendered 20 Hz frames; collision, contact, passage, force, damage, and dwell predicates are sampled after every completed physics interval.
assets: Independently authored full-scale separating screen: sourced outer diameter 0.3683 m and depth 0.0635 m; assumed 0.003 m walls/floor, 0.150 m perforated radius, 261 square apertures of 0.0127 m clear width, 0.003 m ribs on 0.0157 m pitch, 0.40 kg mass, and two connected grasp tabs.

Twenty-four free rigid ceramic angle-cut media bodies: sourced diameter 0.009525 m and axial envelope 0.022225 m; assumed 15 deg cuts and 2500 kg/m^3 density; frozen mesh mass approximately 0.003482 kg each.

Four representative steel washer assemblies: 0.030 m outer diameter, 0.008 m bore, 0.004 m thickness, density 7850 kg/m^3, four rigid arc segments, and four breakable fixed joints; these are disclosed representative workpieces rather than a claimed commercial SKU.
Rigid receiver 0.450 by 0.400 by 0.050 m with 0.005 m floor/walls, rooted at world (0.300,0,0.750) m; its scoring free volume excludes the authored support-post intrusions.

Two fixed support assemblies, each using two 0.008 m diameter posts at screen-relative x=±0.125 m and y=±0.115 m, plus a 0.280 by 0.012 by 0.003 m bottom bar embedded in the receiver floor. The screen floor top is nominally z=0.813 m and rim top z=0.8765 m.
Rigid open-mouth feed cup: 0.078 m outer diameter, 0.100 m height, 0.003 m walls/floor, 0.10 kg assumed mass, initially centered at world (0.160,0.360,0.800) m with a physically closed bottom.

Pinned public YAM asset and guarded 14D joint-action interface. Production physics is 240 Hz with 20 Hz actions held for 12 completed intervals; paired refinement is 480 Hz with the identical seed and time-indexed action sequence.

Industrial evidence preserved from Raytech manual-screening, ceramic-media, and separation guidance. Every third-party asset must receive an explicit license entry; task-specific geometry is independently authored.
approximations: Only dry rigid-body separation is modeled. Polishing, abrasion, liquid, wet cohesion, dust, wear, lubrication, and actual plastic deformation are excluded.

Aperture layout, mass, tabs, support fixtures, receiver, cup, media cuts/density, representative washers, segmented damage model, 200 N joint threshold, and all safety tolerances are disclosed engineering assumptions rather than manufacturer CAD or calibrated product limits.

Uncalibrated contacts use ceramic/polymer static/dynamic friction 0.50/0.35, steel/polymer 0.45/0.35, media/media 0.40/0.30, restitution 0.05, contact offset 0.00015 m, rest offset 0 m, and 32/8 solver position/velocity iterations. Any higher-friction grasp zone must be visibly authored and disclosed as a textured handle surface.

The 180 N external-force limit, 0.5 mm dynamic penetration limit, 1 mm fixture penetration limit, 2 mm/1 deg pose-stationarity envelope, 60 mm release clearance, and three-second dwell are explicit conservative assumptions requiring native qualification.
delta=0.0005 m is solely a numerical tolerance. It does not enlarge apertures, authorize passage through ribs or solid floor, permit center-only containment, or excuse receiver-wall breach.

Apertures are indexed lexicographically by grid row then column; only complete 0.0127 m squares whose closure lies within the 0.150 m perforated circle are retained. The central aperture AP(0,0) is used for diagnostics. World rotations use active extrinsic Rz(yaw)Ry(pitch)Rx(roll).

End-first diagnostics use yaw=[0,18,…,342] deg, the medium long axis within 5 deg of gravity, initial collider clearance >=0.001 m, zero velocity, and 1.0 s simulation. Success requires genuine whole-collider passage. Transverse trials use the same yaw list with the long axis horizontal and otherwise identical conditions.

Bridge diagnostics begin from the 20 transverse transforms. A seed qualifies after support by at least two distinct ribs for 0.5 s. Then a native hinge drive commands theta=5 deg*sin(2*pi*t) for 2 s and returns to zero. Use seeds 788901 upward until exactly 20 qualified trials exist; retain every rejected seed and reason.

Washer escape uses ten frozen orientations per washer over AP(0,0), initial clearance >=0.001 m, zero velocity, and 2.0 s gravity simulation. Any segment crossing below the screen floor bottom is escape. Bore-lodging uses 20 fixed media orientations and requires full-collider intersection with the exact 8 mm bore prism for 0.5 consecutive seconds without robot or external constraint.

The production layout is a proposed full-task design, not a validated result. Actual generated-CAD clearances, installed-URDF full-rotation IK, joint margins, whole-path collisions, cup packing, native settling, screen/support contact, and receiver capacity must pass before robot-demo development.

The external-force diagnostic closes both grippers symmetrically on the tabs for 0.5 s, raises the screen reference 0.03 m over 0.5 s, and holds it for 3 s using guarded 20 Hz joint targets. Force is max_k |sum J_pair,k|/dt over SC contacts against GR, SU, and ENV.

The signed-distance manifest includes SC–SU, SC–FC, SC–RC, SC–ENV, SC–GR, M–SC, M–FC, M–RC, M–SU, M–ENV, M–GR, distinct M–M, M–WS, WS–SC, WS–FC, WS–RC, WS–SU, WS–ENV, WS–GR, and applicable WS–WS pairs. Only same-rigid-body, authored adjacent joined segments, and pinned YAM self-filter pairs are excluded. Missing or unexpectedly filtered required pairs fail qualification.

Production and 480 Hz refinement trials replay identical seeds and time-indexed guarded joint actions. Refinement is a validation run, not an alternate scoring opportunity. A successful expert may terminate after genuine full-score dwell; 4800 controls is the maximum episode length.

Existing empty-screen evidence establishes only a 240 Hz native component result: 35.06 mm lift, 3.2 s pose-stationary hold, and 80.17 mm terminal clearance. It does not establish loaded-scene feasibility, instantaneous-velocity stationarity, refinement equivalence, scoring correctness, or full-task success.
scoring_spec: At reset freeze masses, collider manifests, SV, RV, aperture polygons, fixture exclusions, and approach prisms. Let M0 be total mass of the 24 media and four intact washer assemblies and MM0 the initial media mass. valid_admission(b)=1 only after b completes FEED→EXITED_FEED→ENTERED_SCREEN through the physical cup mouth and screen volume without a hard failure; continuous contact transfer is allowed. F=clamp(sum_b(m_b*valid_admission(b))/M0,0,1). causal_passage(i)=1 persistently only after valid admission and a genuine whole-collider aperture crossing satisfying swept aperture/rib rules. full_inside_screen is the all-convex-part and swept-edge SV predicate defined in damage_rules. eligible_receiver(i,k)=1 iff causal_passage(i)=1, every convex part and swept edge is inside RV with intended overlap no deeper than delta, and i has never spilled, exited RV, become inaccessible, entered by an invalid path, penetrated an RC wall deeper than delta, or incurred invalid provenance. Receiver-contained always means eligible_receiver=1, never a center test. complete_loading holds iff all 28 assemblies are validly admitted, every washer segment is full_inside_screen, and each medium is either full_inside_screen or eligible_receiver. r=clamp(sum_i(m_i*eligible_receiver(i,k))/MM0,0,1); eligibility is recomputed each physics sample and revoked when prerequisites fail. washer_retained requires all washer segments inside SV and all authored joints intact with no damage predicate. supported requires resolved contact with both distinct support groups, screen floor height within 0.002 m of the support plane, |roll|<=3 deg, |pitch|<=3 deg, and screen-center projection inside x=[0.04,0.56], y=[-0.10,0.10] m. clear requires signed distance from every gripper collider to SC∪M∪WS >=0.060 m. Hard failure H is any washer damage or loss, media spill, receiver contamination, invalid provenance, unauthorized staging, forbidden mutation, invalid/tunneled passage, or deterministic inaccessibility. Q=1 iff complete_loading, F=1, r>=0.98, washer_retained, supported, clear, and H=0. Dwell starts at k0 when Q first becomes true, with zero elapsed time on that sample. D=1 only after Q remains true for at least 720 consecutive completed 240 Hz intervals; any false prerequisite resets k0 and immediately revokes D. Base B=0.20F+0.70*clamp(r/0.98,0,1)+0.10D. Final score S=0 if H=1, otherwise S=B. Score is reported at 20 Hz from the latest completed physics sample, and O_57600 is processed before timeout. Observable reference states are: untouched=0; complete valid loading with zero recovery=0.20; 12 of 24 equal-mass media eligible with F=1 and D=0 gives 0.5571428571; r>=0.98 without dwell gives 0.90; valid released three-second dwell gives 1.00. Hand identity, action count, shake count, and action order are not graded.

required_controls.name: control_untouched_reset_zero
required_controls.reason: Fresh reset has F=r=D=0 and no initial success.

required_controls.name: control_complete_loading_zero_recovery
required_controls.reason: All assemblies are validly admitted, F=1, r=0, D=0, and no hard failure occurs.

required_controls.name: control_half_recovery_baseline
required_controls.reason: F=1, exactly 12 equal-mass media are eligible in RV, washers are retained, and D=0.

required_controls.name: control_threshold_recovery_unreleased
required_controls.reason: F=1 and r>=0.98, but support or clearance is false, so D=0.

required_controls.name: control_released_supported_full_dwell
required_controls.reason: All full-score prerequisites remain true for 720 completed physics intervals.

required_controls.name: control_timeout_exact_720_dwell
required_controls.reason: Q is true from O_56880 through processed O_57600, providing exactly 720 intervals.

required_controls.name: control_timeout_719_dwell
required_controls.reason: Threshold recovery holds but Q spans only 719 completed intervals.

required_controls.name: control_continuous_contact_admission
required_controls.reason: All bodies cross the cup mouth into SV without an artificial free-flight gap; F=1 and r=D=0.

required_controls.name: control_early_passage_then_loading
required_controls.reason: Valid passages precede final admission; later F=1 and r>=0.98 with D=0.

required_controls.name: control_receiver_exit_revokes_recovery
required_controls.reason: A previously eligible medium exits RV, latching immutable spill.

required_controls.name: control_native_joint_break_hardzero
required_controls.reason: Any native washer JOINT_BREAK event is destruction and permanently hard-fails the trial.

required_controls.name: control_settled_joint_residual_hardzero
required_controls.reason: A settled washer exceeds the declared persistent joint-frame residual bound.

required_controls.name: control_force_without_damage
required_controls.reason: Threshold recovery holds with D=0; force reaches 200 N but no break or residual damage predicate occurs.

required_controls.name: control_supported_receiver_contact_tolerance
required_controls.reason: All recovered media remain eligible with intended receiver overlap no deeper than delta.

required_controls.name: control_receiver_wall_breach_failure
required_controls.reason: A medium penetrates an RC wall deeper than delta.

required_controls.name: control_valid_full_collider_passage
required_controls.reason: F=1, r>=0.98, D=0, and every credited passage satisfies swept whole-collider geometry.

required_controls.name: control_rib_sweep_breach_failure
required_controls.reason: A swept rib overlap deeper than delta or unqualified crossing latches invalid passage.

required_controls.name: control_direct_cup_receiver_shortcut
required_controls.reason: A medium enters RV without admission into SV and genuine aperture passage.

required_controls.name: control_separate_washer_staging
required_controls.reason: A washer segment is externally supported outside FC and SC for at least 12 physics intervals.

required_controls.name: control_individual_media_robot_contact
required_controls.reason: A GR–M contact pair persists for 12 consecutive physics intervals.

required_controls.name: control_single_media_over_rim_spill
required_controls.reason: One medium exits over the screen rim; re-entry cannot clear spill.

required_controls.name: control_partial_washer_escape
required_controls.reason: Any washer segment exits over the rim or crosses the floor without genuine passage.

required_controls.name: control_receiver_contamination
required_controls.reason: A collider in contaminant set C intersects RV eroded inward by delta.

required_controls.name: control_clearance_dwell_revocation
required_controls.reason: After D=1, a gripper approaches within 0.060 m while F=1 and r>=0.98 remain true.

required_controls.name: control_support_dwell_revocation
required_controls.reason: After D=1, contact with one support group is lost while non-dwell progress remains valid.

required_controls.name: control_forbidden_state_mutation
required_controls.reason: A post-reset task-object state write, teleport, fake weld, collider disablement, freeze, or hidden force occurs.

required_controls.name: control_screen_supported_contact_tolerance
required_controls.reason: F=1, r=0, D=0; contents rest on screen surfaces with penetration no deeper than delta.

required_controls.name: control_screen_floor_breach_failure
required_controls.reason: A body crosses a rib, solid floor, or floor bottom deeper than delta without genuine passage.

required_controls.name: control_incidental_direct_contact_exempt
required_controls.reason: A GR–M contact lasts 11 intervals and ends, so direct-contact provenance does not latch.

required_controls.name: control_direct_contact_threshold_fault
required_controls.reason: A GR–M or GR–WS pair remains true for 12 intervals and latches on the twelfth sample.

required_controls.name: control_receiver_boundary_touch_not_contamination
required_controls.reason: A contaminant only touches the RC boundary or overlaps by at most delta without entering eroded RV.

required_controls.name: control_receiver_foreign_interior_contamination
required_controls.reason: A frozen contaminant intersects receiver free volume eroded inward by delta.

required_controls.name: control_pose_stationary_loaded_hold
required_controls.reason: F=1 and r=0 while the loaded screen stays within the 2 mm/1 deg envelope for three seconds; the hold itself adds no score.
